t4672.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿIkrima b. ʿAmmār al-ʿIjlī, Abū ʿAmmār al-Yamāmī, originally from Basra, as truthful but prone to error, with confusion in his transmission from Yaḥyā b. Abī Kathīr; he had no book, was of the fifth generation, and died shortly before the sixties.
as: وفي روايته عن يحيى بن أبي كثير اضطراب
In his transmission from Yaḥyā b. Abī Kathīr there is confusion.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
مضطرب الحديث عن غير إياس بن سلمة، وكان حديثه عن إياس بن سلمة صالحا
His hadith from transmitters apart from Iyās ibn Salamah is inconsistent. His hadith from Iyās was acceptable.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was unlettered and had a strong memory for hadith.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
أحاديث عكرمة بن عمار عن يحيى بن أبي كثير ليست بذاك، مناكير كان يحيى بن سعيد يضعفهما
His hadith from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr was weak, with objectionable reports. Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd weakened the two of them.
مضطرب في حديث يحيى بن أبي كثير ولم يكن عنده كتاب
Inconsistent in the hadith of Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr. He had no written collection.
ثقة، وفي حديثه عن يحيى بن أبي كثير اضطراب، كان أحمد بن حنبل يقدم عليه ملازم بن عمرو.
Reliable, but inconsistent in his hadith from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr. Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal preferred Mulāzim ibn ʿAmr to him.
ليس به بأس إلا في حديثه عن يحيى بن أبي كثير
There is no objection to him except in his hadith from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان صدوقا، وربما وهم في حديثه، وربما دلس، وفي حديثه عن يحيى بن أبي كثير بعض الأغاليط.
He was truthful, but sometimes made mistakes in his hadith and sometimes obscured his sources. His reports from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr contain some errors.
إسحاق بن أحمد بن خلف البخاري الحافظ, quoted by al-Mizzī
عكرمة بن عمار ثقة، روى عنه سفيان الثوري وذكره بالفضل، وكان كثير الغلط ينفرد عن إياس بأشياء لا يشاركه فيها أحد.
ʿIkrimah is reliable. Sufyān al-Thawrī transmitted from him and spoke of his merit. He made many errors and transmitted things from Iyās that no one else transmitted.
He was truthful, with objectionable material in his hadith.
مستقيم الحديث إذا روى عنه ثقة.
His hadith is sound when a reliable transmitter narrates from him.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
مضطرب الحديث عن يحيى بن أبي كثير
His hadith from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr is inconsistent.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان عكرمة بن عمار عند أصحابنا ثقة ثبتا
Our colleagues considered ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār reliable and precise.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī

t5684.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records al-Layth ibn Saʿd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Fahmī, Abū al-Ḥārith al-Miṣrī, as trustworthy, firm, a jurist and a well-known leader, of the seventh generation; he died in Shaʿbān of the year 75.
as: Trustworthy, firm, a jurist and a well-known leader
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
الليث بن سعد ثقة، ولكن في أخذه سهولة
Al-Layth ibn Saʿd is reliable, though he was lenient in how he accepted material.
عمرو بن علي, quoted by al-Mizzī
الليث أفقه من مالك إلا أن أصحابه لم يقوموا به
Al-Layth had a deeper grasp of jurisprudence than Mālik, though his pupils did not carry his work forward.
He was trustworthy, with many hadiths, and sound in them.
أبو عبد الله, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما في هؤلاء المصريين أثبت من الليث بن سعد
None of these Egyptians is firmer than al-Layth ibn Saʿd.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
الليث بن سعد كثير العلم، صحيح الحديث
Al-Layth has much knowledge and sound hadith.
يحيي ابن معين, quoted by al-Mizzī
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
صدوق، قلت: يحتج بحديثه؟ قال: إي لعمري
Truthful; asked whether his hadith is used as proof: yes, by my life.
Yaʿqūb ibn Shaybah, quoted by al-Mizzī
الليث بن سعد ثقة، وهو دونهم في الزهري يعني دون مالك، ومعمر، وسفيان بن عيينة، وفي حديثه عن الزهري بعض الاضطراب
Trustworthy, but below Mālik, Maʿmar and Ibn ʿUyaynah for al-Zuhrī, and his hadith from al-Zuhrī has some inconsistency.
يا أبا عبد الله إنه لصدوق
Ibn Wahb told Mālik: he is truly truthful.
يحيى بن بكير, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت أحدا أكمل من الليث بن سعد
I have not seen anyone more complete than al-Layth ibn Saʿd.
ورأيت من رأيت فلم أر مثل الليث
I have seen whom I have seen, and I never saw anyone like al-Layth.
Al-Layth followed transmitted reports more closely than Mālik.
الليث أفقه من مالك، ولكن كانت الحظوة لمالك
Al-Layth was more learned in law than Mālik, but the favour went to Mālik.
أحمد بن صالح, quoted by al-Mizzī
إمام قد أوجب الله علينا حقه
An imam whose due God has made binding on us.
شرحبيل بن جميل بن يزيد, quoted by al-Mizzī
وإنهم ليعرفون لليث فضله، وورعه، وحسن إسلامه
The scholars recognised al-Layth's merit, scrupulousness and good practice of Islam while he was still young.
لم يبق أحد أعلم بما حمل منه
The caliph (al-Mahdī): no one remains more knowledgeable of what he carries than him.
يحيى بن سعيد الأنصاري, quoted by al-Mizzī
You are an imam whom people look to.
Mālik ibn Anas, quoted by al-Mizzī
وأنت في إمامتك، وفضلك، ومنزلتك من أهل بلدك
Mālik's letter acknowledged his leadership, merit and standing among his people.
Were it not for al-Layth and Mālik we would have gone astray.
He was reliable and transmitted many sound hadiths.

t915.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jābir al-Bajalī as a well-known Companion who died in 51 AH, or it is said later.
as: The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
إنه سيدخل عليكم من هذا الفج من خير ذي يمن، ألا وإن على وجهه مسحة ملك
One of the best men of Yemen will come to you through this pass. His face has a trace of kingliness.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
O God, make him one who guides and is guided.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت رجلا أحسن من صورة جرير، إلا ما بلغنا من صورة يوسف عليه السلام
I have seen no man more handsome than Jarīr, except for what we have heard about Joseph.
عمر ابن الخطاب, quoted by al-Mizzī
Jarīr is the Joseph of this community.
عبد الملك بن عمير, quoted by al-Mizzī
رأيت جرير بن عبد الله، وكان وجهه شقة قمر
I saw Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh. His face was like a piece of the moon.
يرحمك الله نعم السيد كنت في الجاهلية، ونعم السيد أنت في الإسلام
May God have mercy on you. You were a fine leader before Islam and are a fine leader in Islam.
He was a leader among his people.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
When a man held in honor by his people comes to you, honor him.
عمر, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
He is the Joseph of this community.
عمر, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما أرى أحدا من الناس صور صورة هذا إلا ما ذكر من يوسف
I know of no one with looks like his, except for what is related of Joseph.
النبي, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
When a man honored by his people comes to you, honor him.
علي, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
Jarīr is one of our household, in a report attributed to the Prophet.
أنس بن مالك, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان جرير يخدمني، وهو أكبر مني
Jarīr used to serve me though he was older than I.
ابن إسحاق, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
جرير بن عبد الله البجلي سيد قبيلته، يعني بجيلة
Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Bajalī was chief of his tribe, Bajīlah.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
يطلع عليكم خير ذي يمن، كأن على وجهه مسحة ملك
The best of the people of Yemen will appear before you, with an air of kingliness on his face.
عمر, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
جرير بن عبد الله يوسف هذه الأمة
Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh is the Joseph of this community.
عمر, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
يا جرير، ما زلت سيدا في الجاهلية والإسلام
Jarīr, you have been a leader before and after Islam.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
O God, make him firm and make him one who guides and is guided.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
If a man honored among his people comes to you, honor him.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
Jarīr is the Joseph of this community.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
When a distinguished man of a people comes to you, honor him.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
O God, make him one who guides and is guided.
